header.name: flywheel
header.tagline: Run an AI task with any model. Keep a record you can recheck offline.

flows.title: What happens to a task after you send it
flows.alt: Eight stages from task to offline recheck, with a refusal path back to the tool request, ending in match, changed or unverifiable.
flows.footnote: Every stage writes a receipt. The last stage needs no network and no model.

stages.title: Task
stages.note: Your prompt, and the model you picked from your own roster.

stages.title: Route
stages.note: Local or hosted. Keys are reported present or absent, never read out.

stages.title: Tool request
stages.note: The model asks to read, write, run a command, or call a companion tool.

stages.title: Capability check
stages.note: The request is classified, then allowed or refused before anything runs.

stages.title: Execute
stages.note: The allowed call runs. Its arguments and its output are hashed.

stages.title: Receipt
stages.note: Capability, outcome, both hashes, and the hash of the receipt before it.

stages.title: Ledger
stages.note: Receipts form an ordered chain. One broken link is visible from either end.

stages.title: Recheck
stages.note: Recompute the chain later with no network and no model in the loop.

returns.label: REFUSED, WITH THE REASON RETURNED TO THE MODEL

cards.kicker: the capability check, one command at a time
cards.title: What a shell command is allowed to do, and why
cards.alt: Seven shell commands and what the capability check does with each of them. A dangerous word inside quotes is a printed string and runs, while the same word reached through a command substitution is found and blocked. A pipe records both of its capability classes even though one of them names the decision. An environment prefix does not hide the executable behind it. A command that will not parse is escalated to a person rather than admitted. The marked row is the honest gap: an executable the curated map has never seen is admitted, and written down as unknown.
cards.footnote: The decision names a capability class rather than a matched keyword, so it composes with the receipt written beside it. That trace carries the class, a reason code and a hash of the arguments, never the command itself. The map of names behind it is curated by hand and covers what it lists, nothing further.

fields.note: Quotes are parsed before capabilities are read, so the delete here is an argument to echo.

fields.value: runs, a search over a file
fields.note: A denied name inside a quoted argument is text. Only the executable position is classified.
The substitution runs first, so the tree is walked into and the outer echo settles nothing.
Egress names the decision because it comes first. The download-and-run finding rides along in the record.
A variable set ahead of a command is a prefix. The walk steps over it and reads what follows.
Anything the parser cannot read is held back. A person sees it rather than a shell.
The map of names is curated and short. Anything absent from it is allowed so an oracle can work.
